; Annex M2 — the runtime: a host that loads apps from disk, and sidebar
; entries generated from whatever is installed.
;
; M1 proved the one thing that could have killed the design: a host parented
; inside the navigator draws over the library and *under* an open document, so
; an app is simply still there when the reader closes. That stacking is bought
; at the anchor below (LOCATE AFTER ALL) and is not patched afterwards.
;
; # Why there is not a single hash in this file
;
; qmldiff has two failure modes and they are not equally survivable:
;
;   * a **selector that does not match** is logged as "Error while processing
;     file tree" and the *original* file is returned (src/lib.rs). xochitl runs
;     on, without Annex. This is the failure we are willing to have.
;
;   * a **hashed identifier the hashtab cannot resolve** reaches
;     `panic!("{:?}", e); // temporary solution.` in
;     src/parser/diff/hash_processor.rs. A panic inside xochitl is a dead UI.
;     That is exactly how AppLoad bricked this device on 3.28:
;     "Couldn't resolve the hashed identifier ... required by AppLoad hooks".
;
; **Every identifier here is a name, never a hash.** The panic path is not
; carefully avoided, it is unreachable. Names also survive an OS bump that
; hashes do not: the hashtab is per build, the names are not.
;
; # The anchors, all five of them
;
;   Navigator.qml      : FocusScope                           (file root type)
;   Navigator.qml      : AFTER ALL                            (no anchor)
;   Sidebar.qml        : FocusScope > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
;   Sidebar.qml        : ArkControls.SidebarFoldout#integrationsFoldout
;   GesturesWindow.qml : BaseView > Item#globalGestures
;
; The blocks are independent on purpose, and they degrade in that order: if a
; Sidebar anchor moves there is no way *in* but the host still installs; if a
; gestures anchor moves the apps still run and only the escape gesture is lost.
; Each is a recoverable failure rather than a broken device. `annex-retarget`
; re-derives these; see docs/MAINTENANCE.
;
; Comment syntax: `;` is qmldiff's and is only legal *outside* an INSERT block.
; Inside one the content is QML, where `;` separates statements — a `;` comment
; there is parsed as code and the whole file fails to load with "expected item
; assignment value token". Use `//` inside INSERT blocks.

AFFECT `/qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml`
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        ; Reachable from Sidebar.qml as navigator.annexHost. An alias may name
        ; an id that appears later in the file.
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property alias annexHost: annexHost
        }

        ; **The host goes last, inside the navigator.** The whole stacking
        ; decision, made once, here:
        ;
        ;   - last child of the navigator  -> draws over the library chrome
        ;   - inside the navigator branch  -> the document view, which is later
        ;                                     in MainView, draws over it
        ;
        ; So an app covers the library and steps behind a document the moment
        ; one opens, with no z value anywhere. AppLoad did this until v0.5.0;
        ; v0.5.1 moved its parent up to MainView, which is what made the reader
        ; open *behind* apps and cost a day to work around.
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: annexHost
                objectName: "annexHost"
                anchors.fill: parent
                visible: false

                // ---- the installed apps -------------------------------------
                //
                // Discovered at startup by reading an index written by
                // `annex-index` and then each app's own manifest. Apps live on
                // the filesystem and are loaded with file:// URLs — there is no
                // resource bundle to build, which is the main reason writing an
                // Annex app is less ceremony than writing an AppLoad one.
                //
                // QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ=1 is set on xochitl by
                // qt-resource-rebuilder's own drop-in, which is what makes the
                // reading possible at all.

                property string annexRoot: "/home/root/annex"
                property var apps: []
                property string currentId: ""

                // ---- the escape hatch's one-consumed-in-a-row guard ---------
                //
                // escapeWindowMs bounds how long an app's "I handled that
                // swipe" is honoured before the *next* swipe closes the host
                // regardless of what the app says. 2000ms: long enough that a
                // deliberate second swipe — thrown right after the first,
                // because the first only left an inner view — still lands
                // inside it, short enough that a genuine second escape minutes
                // later is offered to the app fresh rather than treated as
                // part of the same gesture. lastEscapeConsumedAt resets to 0
                // (outside the window forever) whenever the host closes, an
                // app is opened, or an app declines/throws — so only an
                // unbroken pair of app-consumed escapes can trigger it, never
                // a stale one from a previous app or session.
                property real escapeWindowMs: 2000
                property real lastEscapeConsumedAt: 0

                function read(path, done) {
                    var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                    xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                        if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
                        done(xhr.status === 0 || xhr.status === 200 ? xhr.responseText : null);
                    };
                    try {
                        xhr.open("GET", "file://" + path);
                        xhr.send();
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.log("[annex] cannot read " + path + ": " + e);
                        done(null);
                    }
                }

                function discover() {
                    read(annexRoot + "/apps.index", function(txt) {
                        if (!txt) {
                            console.log("[annex] no apps.index; no apps installed");
                            return;
                        }
                        var dirs = txt.split("\n").filter(function(l) {
                            return l.length > 0 && l.charAt(0) === "/";
                        });
                        var found = [];
                        var pending = dirs.length;
                        if (pending === 0) { annexHost.apps = []; return; }
                        function done() {
                            if (--pending > 0)
                                return;
                            found.sort(function(a, b) { return a.name < b.name ? -1 : 1; });
                            annexHost.apps = found;
                            console.log("[annex] " + found.length + " app(s) installed");
                        }

                        for (var i = 0; i < dirs.length; ++i) {
                            (function(dir) {
                                annexHost.read(dir + "/manifest.json", function(m) {
                                    if (!m) { done(); return; }
                                    var j;
                                    try {
                                        j = JSON.parse(m);
                                    } catch (e) {
                                        console.log("[annex] " + dir + ": bad manifest: " + e);
                                        done();
                                        return;
                                    }
                                    if (!j.id || !j.name || !j.entry) {
                                        console.log("[annex] " + dir + ": manifest needs id, name and entry");
                                        done();
                                        return;
                                    }
                                    j.dir = dir;

                                    // `icon` is a path relative to the app's own
                                    // directory, made absolute here so the
                                    // delegate has nothing to work out. See the
                                    // note on iconSource in the Sidebar block
                                    // for the one rule that matters: no scheme.
                                    if (j.icon)
                                        j.iconPath = dir + "/" + j.icon;

                                    found.push(j);
                                    done();
                                });
                            })(dirs[i]);
                        }
                    });
                }

                Component.onCompleted: discover()

                // ---- opening and closing an app -----------------------------
                //
                // The app contract is deliberately AppLoad's: the root element
                // may declare `signal close` and `function unloading()`. An app
                // written for AppLoad needs no change here, which is what makes
                // porting one a matter of the manifest and the socket path.

                function appById(id) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < apps.length; ++i)
                        if (apps[i].id === id) return apps[i];
                    return null;
                }

                function open(id) {
                    var a = appById(id);
                    if (!a) { console.log("[annex] no such app: " + id); return; }
                    if (currentId === id && appLoader.item) { visible = true; return; }
                    closeCurrent();
                    currentId = id;
                    // A fresh app gets a fresh chance at the next escape; it
                    // never inherits whatever the previous app consumed.
                    lastEscapeConsumedAt = 0;
                    console.log("[annex] opening " + id + " from " + a.dir);
                    appLoader.setSource("file://" + a.dir + "/" + a.entry);
                    visible = true;
                }

                function closeCurrent() {
                    if (appLoader.item && typeof appLoader.item.unloading === "function") {
                        try { appLoader.item.unloading(); }
                        catch (e) { console.log("[annex] unloading() threw: " + e); }
                    }
                    appLoader.setSource("");
                    currentId = "";
                    lastEscapeConsumedAt = 0;
                }

                function close() {
                    visible = false;
                    closeCurrent();
                }

                // ---- the escape gesture --------------------------------------
                //
                // An app's root element may declare `function escapeRequested()
                // -> bool`. Returning true means it handled the swipe itself
                // (popped its own inner view) and the host stays open. Anything
                // else — false, no such function, a throw, a non-boolean —
                // closes the host exactly as if the app had not declared it at
                // all.
                //
                // The guarantee this must not break: an app that always
                // returns true must never be able to trap the user. So the
                // host honours at most one consumed escape in a row — see
                // escapeWindowMs above — and a second swipe within that window
                // closes the host no matter what the app returns.
                function escape() {
                    var now = Date.now();
                    if (lastEscapeConsumedAt && (now - lastEscapeConsumedAt) < escapeWindowMs) {
                        // The app already consumed one; this is the very next
                        // swipe, so it gets the user out unconditionally.
                        lastEscapeConsumedAt = 0;
                        console.log("[annex] escape swipe: second in a row, closing host");
                        close();
                        return;
                    }

                    var consumed = false;
                    if (appLoader.item && typeof appLoader.item.escapeRequested === "function") {
                        try {
                            consumed = appLoader.item.escapeRequested() === true;
                        } catch (e) {
                            console.log("[annex] escapeRequested() threw: " + e);
                            consumed = false;
                        }
                    }

                    if (consumed) {
                        lastEscapeConsumedAt = now;
                        console.log("[annex] escape swipe: consumed by " + currentId);
                    } else {
                        lastEscapeConsumedAt = 0;
                        console.log("[annex] escape swipe: closing host");
                        close();
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    color: "white"

                    // Swallow taps so the library underneath cannot be operated
                    // through an app that is covering it.
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent }

                    Loader {
                        id: appLoader
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        asynchronous: false

                        onLoaded: {
                            if (!item) return;
                            // An app closes itself by emitting `close`, exactly
                            // as under AppLoad.
                            if (item.close && typeof item.close.connect === "function")
                                item.close.connect(annexHost.close);
                            // Hand the app its own directory so it can find its
                            // own files without knowing where Annex installed it.
                            var a = annexHost.appById(annexHost.currentId);
                            if (a && item.annexAppDir !== undefined)
                                item.annexAppDir = a.dir;
                        }

                        onStatusChanged: {
                            if (status === Loader.Error)
                                console.log("[annex] failed to load " + annexHost.currentId + ": " + sourceComponent);
                        }
                    }

                    // Shown only when an app is open but produced no UI — a
                    // loader error would otherwise be a white screen with no
                    // explanation on a device with no console.
                    Column {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        spacing: 60
                        visible: appLoader.status === Loader.Error

                        Text {
                            width: annexHost.width - 160
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                            font.pixelSize: 34
                            text: "Annex could not load \"" + annexHost.currentId +
                                  "\".\n\nIts entry QML failed to load. The reason is in the log."
                        }

                        // An explicit way out, here and nowhere else.
                        //
                        // The swipe is the universal hatch, but a user who has
                        // just been handed an error screen should not also have
                        // to know a gesture. This is the one screen where a
                        // host-drawn control is safe to put anywhere it likes:
                        // the app failed to load, so there is no app content to
                        // be in a fight with.
                        Text {
                            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                            font.pixelSize: 34
                            font.underline: true
                            color: leaveArea.pressed ? "#909090" : "#000000"
                            text: "Back to library"

                            MouseArea {
                                id: leaveArea
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                anchors.margins: -40
                                onClicked: annexHost.close()
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // The escape hatch is not here. It is xochitl's own
                    // swipe-from-the-top filter, attached in the third AFFECT
                    // block at the bottom of this file — see the long note
                    // there for why it moved out of this one.
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT `/qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml`
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        ; One entry per installed app, generated from the manifests rather than
        ; written here. Adding an app is dropping a directory and re-running
        ; `annex-index`; this file does not change.
        LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.SidebarFoldout#integrationsFoldout
        INSERT {
            Repeater {
                id: annexEntries
                objectName: "annexEntries"
                model: navigator.annexHost ? navigator.annexHost.apps : []

                delegate: ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                    objectName: "annexEntry_" + modelData.id
                    text: modelData.name
                    enabled: true
                    Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width

                    // An app's own icon, from its manifest, beside xochitl's.
                    //
                    // **An absolute path with no scheme.** This slot is not a
                    // plain Image: SidebarItem hands the source to an ark
                    // `Icon`, which calls
                    // `ArkImageDataProvider.resolveImageInfo(source, ...)` and
                    // renders the SVG itself. That provider takes a filesystem
                    // path or a `qrc:` path and nothing else. Measured against
                    // it directly on 3.28.0.172:
                    //
                    //   /home/root/annex/apps/quire/icon.svg   -> 48x48   ok
                    //   file:///home/root/annex/apps/quire/icon.svg -> -1x-1
                    //   qrc:/ark/icons/ebook                   -> 48x48   ok
                    //
                    // So a `file://` URL fails, and so does a data: URI — both
                    // report "Could not find", which reads like a missing file
                    // and is really an unsupported source. An app therefore
                    // ships its icon as a plain file in its own directory and
                    // needs no resource bundle for it.
                    //
                    // The stock icons are 48x48 SVGs of solid black paths, and
                    // an app matching that sits in the sidebar looking like it
                    // belongs. `icon` is optional: without one the source is
                    // empty, the ark Icon makes itself invisible, and the entry
                    // looks exactly as it did before icons existed.
                    iconSource: modelData.iconPath ? modelData.iconPath : ""

                    onClicked: {
                        root.toggle();
                        navigator.annexHost.open(modelData.id);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ============================================================================
; The escape hatch: xochitl's own gesture, not one of ours
; ============================================================================
;
; **Swipe down from the top edge to leave an app.** Not a lookalike — this is
; literally the mechanism xochitl uses to leave a document, with its own
; thresholds and its own edge band.
;
; # Why the host draws nothing
;
; Annex covers the whole navigator, the sidebar included, so the only exit from
; an app used to be the app choosing to offer one. That made "can the user
; leave?" a property of every app written by anybody, which is not a promise a
; framework keeps by asking nicely. Annex's own Loader.Error screen proved the
; point: full-screen, no affordance, so an app with a QML syntax error left the
; device needing ssh to recover.
;
; The first fix was a host-drawn X in a reserved corner. On hardware it failed
; twice over: the glyph was U+2715, which this device's font does not have, so
; it drew as a tofu box — and app content drew on top of it anyway, z and all.
; Both are one problem. *Anything the host draws is in a fight with the app over
; the same pixels*, and the host only wins that fight if every app author
; remembers a reserved rectangle, which is the promise we were trying to stop
; depending on. A gesture takes no pixels: nothing to collide with, nothing to
; hide, no glyph to render.
;
; # Why this is a TouchAreaSwipeFilter and not a DragHandler
;
; A hand-rolled DragHandler was the second attempt and did not fire on device.
; Rather than debug a gesture of our own invention, this uses the one xochitl
; already ships. `SceneViewGestures.qml:476` is how a document is closed:
;
;     TouchAreaSwipeFilter {
;         objectName: "close-scene-view"
;         direction: Qt.point(0, 1)
;         area: Qt.rect(0, 0, touchArea.width - Values.quickSettingsGestureWidth,
;                       touchArea.edgeSize)
;         onTriggered: view.closeGesture();
;     }
;
; The filters attach to an *existing* TouchArea through their `touchArea`
; property rather than creating one, which is the detail that makes this safe:
; Annex adds no touch-handling item over the app, so nothing new can swallow an
; app's taps.
;
; The numbers are xochitl's, read off its own library-screen filters: a 0.3 cm
; swipe, starting inside the top band, across the full width *except* the
; right-hand strip that belongs to the quick-settings swipe. Users get the
; gesture they already have, including the corner where it correctly does
; something else.
;
; # Why this file, and a warning about the resource dump
;
; `NavigatorWindow.qml` and `GesturesWindow.qml` come out of `rccdump` as
; byte-identical files (same md5), so which one the engine loads could not be
; told from the dump. Both were patched with the same selector and the device
; settled it on 2026-09-18:
;
;   Processing /qt/qml/xofm/modules/homescreen/qml/NavigatorWindow.qml...
;   Error while processing file tree: Cannot locate element in tree:
;       BaseView > Item#globalGestures
;   Processing /qt/qml/xofm/modules/gestures/global/qml/GesturesWindow.qml...
;   [annex] escape swipe armed (GesturesWindow)
;
; The selector matched one and not the other, which two identical files cannot
; both do. **So `rccdump` misattributed NavigatorWindow.qml's contents**, and
; what that dump shows for a file is not always what xochitl runs. Read it as a
; strong hint and let the device confirm. The dead block has been removed;
; GesturesWindow is the live one.
;
; This block is independent of the two above: if this anchor moves, apps still
; install and still run, and only the gesture is lost.
;
; # What it does not cover
;
; An app that wedges the QML thread receives no gesture either. `annex-disable
; <id>` over ssh is that backstop and is why the tool exists.
;
; Apps are still encouraged to offer their own way back — "< Library" is the
; discoverable route and is in the app contract. This is the floor under it.

AFFECT `/qt/qml/xofm/modules/gestures/global/qml/GesturesWindow.qml`
    TRAVERSE BaseView > Item#globalGestures
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            QtObject {
                id: annexEscape
                property var cached: null

                function host() {
                    if (annexEscape.cached && annexEscape.cached.objectName === "annexHost")
                        return annexEscape.cached;
                    var top = root;
                    while (top.parent) top = top.parent;
                    var queue = [top];
                    var depth = 0;
                    while (queue.length > 0 && depth < 32) {
                        var next = [];
                        for (var i = 0; i < queue.length; ++i) {
                            var node = queue[i];
                            if (!node) continue;
                            if (node.objectName === "annexHost") {
                                annexEscape.cached = node;
                                return node;
                            }
                            var kids = node.children;
                            if (!kids) continue;
                            for (var k = 0; k < kids.length; ++k)
                                next.push(kids[k]);
                        }
                        queue = next;
                        depth += 1;
                    }
                    return null;
                }
            }

            TouchAreaSwipeFilter {
                objectName: "annexEscapeSwipe"
                touchArea: root.touchArea
                distance: 0.3 * root.pixelsPerCm
                direction: Qt.point(0, 1)
                area: Qt.rect(0, 0,
                              root.width - globalGestures.quickSettingsGestureAreaWidth,
                              globalGestures.quickSettingsGestureAreaHeight)
                Component.onCompleted: console.log("[annex] escape swipe armed (GesturesWindow)")
                onTriggered: {
                    var h = annexEscape.host();
                    console.log("[annex] escape swipe (GesturesWindow): host=" + h +
                                " visible=" + (h ? h.visible : "n/a"));
                    // h.escape() does the deciding — whether the app consumed
                    // the swipe or the host closed — and logs which.
                    if (h && h.visible)
                        h.escape();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
